privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: This page shows your order status. We do not ask for your name, phone number or email. A random ID stored in your browser links your phone to your orders; it is deleted when your orders close. If you allow notifications, your browser's push address is used only to alert you about these orders and is deleted 30 minutes after your last order closes. The restaurant is responsible for your order; Tanbeeh processes this data on its behalf.
